author: history_train_author

review_scope.semantic: Reviewed all 24 selected scientific anchor/clarification mappings and all eight family generators, target-position and correction templates, pending policies, original/corrected versions and branch rules. This is not a claim of 480 individually independent scientific facts or independent source re-verification.

additional_checks.invalid_self_reference_error_after_reord: Independent explicit counterexample passed: an invalid first e1 self-reference would become valid under naïve target-first movement; legal content-preserving control chose e1,e5,e2,e3,e4 and retained failure.
additional_checks.identity_pair_prompt: Independent representative identity pair has byte-identical rendered prompt; author additionally verified all 162 identity pairs.
additional_checks.receipt_resume: Source review confirms complete raw prefix replay, saved prompt hash recomputation and actual-session equality before resuming; no cluster failure recovery receipt is claimed.

resolved_findings.issue: Actual answer already equals the requested replacement, causing invalid no-op _replace.
resolved_findings.resolution: Frozen addressed repeat_answer branch and remappable question; all 96 correction counterfactuals pass.

resolved_findings.issue: Mismatch between intended pending semantics and actual pending was not explicit in fallback question.
resolved_findings.resolution: Frozen fallback asks user to identify intended request and preserves existing pending; 48 wrong-function counterfactuals pass.

resolved_findings.issue: Control-only session_id suffix leaks treatment identity into prompt.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root finding fixed: same session_id on both sides; identity prompt exact.

resolved_findings.issue: Reordering invalid-reference output can turn the original error into a valid answer.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root finding fixed: enumerate legal orders, require same outcomes/error types/displays/scientific args/pending, and preserve explicit identity fallback without discarding B.

remaining_limitations: Initial A/B estimand was prospectively amended from literal old-TRAIN replay versus actual history to earliest-legal-order versus actual order with matched content/reference wording. This is not a pure provenance experiment.

Twenty-four scientific anchors recur across 192 declared scenario families; 360 prefix capture identities contain 336 distinct question sequences. Counts do not establish independence or exhaustive coverage.

Actual checkpoint7205 responses have not been collected locally. Frozen branch policies were stress-tested with 480 all-provider-error and 480 wrong-scientific-call histories, not all possible outputs.
Token balance, source7205 optimizer receipt, runtime parity, training and quality evaluation remain cluster gates. No model/tokenizer/GPU quality result is asserted.
Old scientific contracts and reviewed TRAIN anchors were reused; this review independently checks their use and dialogue semantics, not new scientific truth.

independence.later_dev_equivalence_amendment: Root-requested pre-run correction from the established symmetric rubric; did not use TRAIN contents.

deployment_transformation: Only module import paths change; reviewed source digests retained.
